h2. Description

*Part Sale results do not display a total price*, although the row is specified to show one and every
other money-carrying result type does.

For example, when a search returns a Part Sale:

* The row shows the *P-number*, the *customer*, a *status badge*, who created it and the date.
* No *total price* appears anywhere on the row.
* A *Purchase Order* row on the same screen does show its total, so the row template is capable of it.
* The value is missing from the data the search returns, not only from the display - the search
result for a Part Sale carries status, customer, asset and creator, and no money field at all.

This appears inconsistent with the expected *Part Sale result row* defined in *Epic SV-9160* and
*Global Search - Product Requirements v1.5*.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to ShopView and open *Global Search* using the Search control in the top-right corner, or press *Ctrl + K*.
# Search for {{Fib}}.
# Scroll to the *Part sales* section and observe the row:
#* *P9160-258 ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Commercial*
#* Status badge *Estimate*, then the creator and the date.
#* No amount is shown.
# Look at the *Purchase orders* section immediately below it:
#* *S9160-17652 ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Mining*
#* Status badge *Ordered*, then *$240.00* and the date.
# Compare the two rows.

*Actual Result:*
The Part Sale row shows no total price. Every other field the row is specified to carry is present.

*Expected Result:*
The Part Sale row shows its total price alongside the created date, in the same position a Purchase
Order row shows its total.

h2. Screenshots

!part-sale-row.png|width=684!

_Searching "Fib". The Part Sale row carries no amount; the Purchase Order row directly beneath it,
on the same screen, shows $240.00._

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch [https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com|https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com/]
(build {{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. The record
used is the seeded part sale {{P9160-258}} for {{ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Commercial}}, which is on the
branch now. The same was observed on three further part sales, including the paid
{{P2-58}} for Wellington Truck Repair, so it is not limited to estimates or to seeded data.

h2. Sources

{quote}A Part Sale result shows the P-number and customer name as the main line (for example "P2-58
Toboro Industries"). A status badge is shown. A total price and a created date are shown. A label
icon is shown on the left of the row.{quote}

Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5 - Confluence page 576978945.
